When we went there..was told to pay 2000 to continue..

Treat yourself with remaining two sessions that is.. 500 rs from our end.

There seems to be some misunderstanding. You were absent for more than a month with very infrequent attendance. I had also informed your wife regarding this. Please understand, I pay my tutors for every scheduled session—whether attended or not—as this is their daily livelihood. I had requested a payment of ₹2000 as the next installment, which was due from your side. I also maintain an attendance record to support this.

I believe it would have been better if you had spoken to me directly before posting anything online. That would reflect professional courtesy. Going public instead of discussing with me first does not present your intentions in the right way.
